tha-ap339:1.1: Tiṇakuṭidāyaka.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā ahosiṃ parakammiko / parakammāyane yutto parabhattaṃ apassito. // //
tha-ap339:2.1: Rahogato nisīditvā evaṃ cintesi tāvade: / Buddho loke samuppanno adhikāro *ca n' atthi* me. // //
tha-ap339:3.1: Kālo gatiṃ me sodhetuṃ khaṇo me paṭipādito / dukkho nirayasamphasso apuññānaṃ hi pāṇinaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:4.1: Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna kammasāmim upāgamiṃ / ekāhaṃ kammaṃ *yācitvā pavanaṃ pāvisim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:5.1: Tiṇakaṭṭhañ ca* valliñ ca āharitvān' ahan tadā / tidaṇḍake ṭhapetvāna akaṃ tiṇakuṭim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:6.1: Saṅghassatthāya kuṭikaṃ niyyātetvāna *tam ahaṃ* / tadahe yeva āgantvā kammasāmim upāgamiṃ. // //
tha-ap339:7.1: *Tena kammena sukatena Tāvatiṃsam agacch' ahaṃ / tattha me* sukataṃ vyamhaṃ tiṇakuṭikāya nimmitaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:8.1: Sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu dhajālu haritāmayo / satasahassaniyyūhā vyamhe pātubhaviṃsu me. // //
tha-ap339:9.1: Yaṃ yaṃ yonūpapajjāmi devattam atha mānusaṃ / mama saṅkappam aññāya *pāsādo upatiṭṭhati.* // //
tha-ap339:10.1: Bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso na vijjati / tāsaṃ mamaṃ na jānāmi tiṇakuṭikāy idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:11.1: Sīhavyagghā ca dīpī ca acchakokataracchayo / sabbe maṃ parivajjenti tiṇakuṭikāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:12.1: Siriṃsapā ca bhūtā *ca ahi-kumbhaṇḍa-ra*kkhasā / te pi maṃ parivajjenti tiṇakuṭikāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:13.1: Na pāpasupinassāhaṃ sarāmi dassanaṃ mama / upaṭṭhitā sati mayhaṃ tiṇakuṭikāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:14.1: Tāy' eva tiṇakuṭikāya anubhotvāna sampadā / Gotamassa bhagavato dhammaṃ sacchikarim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:15.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi tiṇakuṭikāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap339:17.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tiṇakuṭidāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
